blind.B1: Yes. Abstract METHODS: Ldlr-/-.Leiden mice on 30 wk HFD, then 20 wk running wheel (exercise), chow switch, or both; liver, WAT, muscle sequenced. Exercise factor = running wheel (GEO runwheel.31-50wk Y: 58 samples). 30-week reference groups are not in GEO (packet A diet columns show only 50-wk animals plus chow reference).
blind.B2: Abstract METHODS/RESULTS: each intervention (exercise HFD+rw, diet change, combination) vs untreated HFD control, per organ. Per-group n from GEO treatment_protocol: HFD control 17, exercise 17, diet 18, combination 18 animals; sequenced n=7-11 per group per organ (liver 10-11, eWAT 8-10, muscle 7-10). Counts per group in packet A: HH 28, HHrw 30, HC 27, HCrw 28, CC 25 across 3 organs. Only the abstract was available; no figure legends.
blind.B3: Yes: the same mouse gives liver, eWAT and muscle samples (extract_protocol: n per group per organ). Key: characteristics_ch1.4.mousenr (65 keys, 120/138 linked, 0 duplicates within an organ; pairing_check supported, p=0.0005). Only relevant if organs are pooled in one model.
blind.B4: The abstract does not say. GEO data_processing names DESeq2 only. Cannot tell joint versus pairwise fits.

checks.evidence: Abstract METHODS: running wheel arm in vivo; GEO runwheel.31-50wk Y=58. Case run.

Packet B grp levels CC25/HC27/HCrw28/HH28/HHrw30 match the GEO code (donor.allergen.dose). Primary contrast HHrw vs HH uses the HFD control, not chow. 30-wk reference groups not in GEO, recorded as discrepancy. Group-to-protocol n per organ not verifiable beyond the abstract.
Contrasts recorded as treatment=HHrw/HCrw/HC, control=HH (or HC for HCrw vs HC); GSEA text labels NES>0 as enriched in treatment.
mousenr links samples across organs only; each organ fitted separately, so one sample per mouse per fit (0 duplicates per level in packet A). Recorded in covariance reasoning.
Paper's fit structure unknown (abstract only). Per-organ joint model on 5 groups was used, recorded as such; pairwise fits not reported.

eWAT: 8 NovaSeq samples all in HCrw/HHrw (platform crosstab); platform covariate added and a no-platform sensitivity run reported (exercise 4 vs 31 DEGs). Liver all NextSeq, muscle all NovaSeq; group housing noted in growth_protocol.
Integer fraction 1.0, max 2.4e6, median 0; HTSeq-count raw counts; DESeq2 per GEO data_processing.
Paper threshold not stated in the abstract; workflow default padj<0.05 with raw p<0.01 audit, deviation recorded.
HANDBACK states comparison is on the abstract only and no paper numbers were compared; no overclaim.

summary: 本案例设计合理:每个器官单独拟合,以 HFD 对照(HH)为参照比较运动组(HHrw),方向、分组、配对(同一小鼠仅跨器官出现)均无问题。eWAT 的平台混杂已记录并做了敏感性分析。论文阈值与模型结构因仅有摘要无法核对,列为待人工确认项。
